description: GLM-5.2 MTP draft layer (GlmMoeDsaForCausalLMNextN) routed MoE per rank: weights are bf16 in this checkpoint (not MXFP4); production kernel aiter fused_moe_ -> CK ck_moe_stage1/2. 257 experts (256 + fused shared), top-9. Used by draft decode (seq_len = 4 x bs_graph, 4 steps / iteration) and draft extend (seq_len = 4 x 6 x bs_graph).

import torch


@torch.no_grad()
def run(hidden_states, topk_ids, topk_weights, w13, w2):
    """Routed bf16 MoE, precomputed routing. w13 rows [0, I) = gate, [I, 2I) = up."""
    I, H = 512, 6144
    M, K = topk_ids.shape
    x = hidden_states.float()
    out = torch.zeros(M, H, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
    ids = topk_ids.to(torch.int64)
    for e in torch.unique(ids).tolist():
        rows, slots = torch.nonzero(ids == e, as_tuple=True)
        g1 = x[rows] @ w13[e].float().t()
        act = torch.nn.functional.silu(g1[:, :I]) * g1[:, I:]
        o = act @ w2[e].float().t()
        out.index_add_(0, rows, o * topk_weights[rows, slots].unsqueeze(1))
    return out.to(torch.bfloat16)
